info.title: Delta Registry — OSM Business Data + DNS Verify - B2B Lead JSON Feed
info.description: Discovers B2B leads from your own seed list or OpenStreetMap's Overpass API (Google Maps excluded on ToS grounds), crawls each site for contact emails, verifies plausibility via DNS/MX, supports BYOK Hunter.io/People Data Labs enrichment, and optionally scores buying intent with Claude Haiku 4.5.

post.summary: Start an async run of: Discovers B2B leads from your own seed list or OpenStreetMap's Overpass API (Google Maps excluded on ToS grounds), crawls each site for contact emails, verifies plausibility via DNS/MX, supports BYOK Hunter.io/People Data Labs enrichment, and optionally scores buying intent with Claude Haiku 4.5.
post.x-async-pattern-reason: No production run history exists for this actor — defaulting to the async run+poll pattern as a precaution, not a measurement. Re-run this generator once real telemetry exists to potentially switch it to sync.

discoveryMode.description: seedList (Mode A): enrich the company names/domains you supply directly - zero discovery-layer risk. osmOverpass (Mode B): discover candidate businesses from OpenStreetMap's Overpass API within a bounding box (ODbL-licensed - Google Maps is intentionally excluded from discovery because its Maps/Earth Additional ToS and Maps Platform ToS both prohibit building a business-listings/mailing-list database from Maps content).

seedList.description: Company names or website domains/URLs to enrich directly. Required (non-empty) when discoveryMode is "seedList". Mixed entries are fine - each is heuristically read as either a bare name ("Acme Corp") or a domain/URL ("acme.com", "https://acme.com").

overpassBbox.description: "south,west,north,east" in decimal degrees, e.g. "50.70,-1.90,50.90,-1.30". Required when discoveryMode is "osmOverpass". Queries the public overpass-api.de mirror, which is fair-use only - budget a self-hosted Overpass instance for production volume.

maxLeads.description: Hard cap on how many candidates are enriched and charged this run.

includeIntentScore.description: When enabled, each lead gets one Claude Haiku 4.5 call scoring hiring-page, funding-news, and tech-stack signals read only from the business's own crawled site text (always paired with a mandatory disclaimer field - a heuristic read of public text, never a verified fact). Bills the enriched_lead PPE event ($0.015/record) instead of basic_lead ($0.002/record). Requires this Actor's own ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable to be configured on the Actor - this is the operator's own compute cost (priced into the Enriched Lead rate), not a customer BYOK field.

hunterApiKey.description: Your own Hunter.io API key. When supplied, this actor calls Hunter.io's domain-search endpoint using YOUR key - Hunter.io bills your own account directly, never this actor's own PPE price.

peopleDataLabsApiKey.description: Your own People Data Labs API key, used and billed the same way as hunterApiKey - your own account is charged by People Data Labs directly.

skipKnownLeads.description: When enabled, a lead already discovered (and charged for) in a prior run of this Actor is skipped before the enrichment waterfall runs - no repeat website crawl, no repeat BYOK/intent-score calls, and no repeat basic_lead/enriched_lead charge for the same business. Identity is a stable id derived from the OSM id (Mode B) or normalized name+domain (Mode A), persisted in this Actor's own key-value store across runs. Leave off (default) for a full re-enrichment on every run, e.g. if a business's own site content may have changed since last time.

201.description: Run started. Poll GET /actor-runs/{runId} with the returned run id until status is SUCCEEDED, then fetch its dataset items.

get.summary: Poll the status of a previously started run.

200.description: Current run status. When status is SUCCEEDED, fetch the dataset via GET /datasets/{datasetId}/items, passing this response's defaultDatasetId field as {datasetId}.

get.summary: Fetch the dataset items produced by a completed run.

200.description: Array of normalized records from the actor run.

record_id.title: Record ID
record_id.description: osm:<type>/<id> for OSM-discovered leads; a deterministic seed:<hash> for seed-list leads - stable across runs for the same input.

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: Always NEW_LISTING - this actor has no cross-run delta-tracking concept.

is_new.title: Is New
is_new.description: true if this exact business (identified by OSM id, or normalized name+domain for seed-list leads) was never seen in a prior run of this Actor; false if it was. Tracked in this Actor's own key-value store regardless of the skipKnownLeads input - that flag only controls whether an already-known lead is skipped, not whether it's tracked. Unlike a registry-monitoring actor, this is a simple seen/not-seen signal, not a richer NEW_LISTING/STATUS_CHANGE/UPDATED/CLOSED classification - a business's own listing has no observable status this actor tracks.

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: The business's own website, when known.

entity_identifier_native.title: Native Entity Identifier
entity_identifier_native.description: Raw OSM type/id (e.g. node/48213456) for OSM discovery; null for seed-list leads (no native source id exists for a customer-typed name).

value_native.title: Value (native)
value_native.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

value_currency.title: Value Currency
value_currency.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

value_usd_normalized.title: Value (USD)
value_usd_normalized.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

effective_date_iso.title: Effective Date
effective_date_iso.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

publish_date_iso.title: Publish Date
publish_date_iso.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

status_or_estado.title: Status
status_or_estado.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

awarding_or_regulating_agency.title: Agency
awarding_or_regulating_agency.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: OSM for Overpass discovery; GLOBAL for seed-list leads (no single jurisdiction applies).

source_document_url.title: Source Document URL
source_document_url.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

reference_number.title: Reference Number
reference_number.description: Not applicable to this actor - always null.

emailsFound.title: Emails Found
emailsFound.description: mailto: links and regex-matched addresses found on the crawled page(s).

emailPlausible.title: Email Plausible
emailPlausible.description: true when the domain has a non-null MX record set (dns.promises.resolveMx). null when no domain was available to check.

websiteContentUnavailable.title: Website Content Unavailable
websiteContentUnavailable.description: true when the site could not be fetched, is disallowed by robots.txt, or looks like a client-side-rendered SPA with no server-delivered content - this actor never escalates to a headless browser.

byokEnrichment.title: BYOK Enrichment
byokEnrichment.description: null when neither hunterApiKey nor peopleDataLabsApiKey was supplied. Otherwise per-provider used/data/error using the CUSTOMER's own key - billed by that vendor to the customer directly, never to this actor's own PPE price.

intentScore.title: Intent Score
intentScore.description: 0-100 heuristic buying-intent score from Claude Haiku 4.5, only when includeIntentScore was enabled and the model call succeeded.

intentScoreDisclaimer.title: Intent Score Disclaimer
intentScoreDisclaimer.description: Mandatory whenever intent scoring was attempted - never omitted. States this is a heuristic LLM read of public text, not a verified fact.
